name: ogenic-phase-vi
description: One OGENIC toolkit for routing, building, migrating, deploying and verifying work across connected providers with Cloudflare as the primary runtime.

interface.shortDescription: One toolkit for all OGENIC work.
interface.longDescription: Routes one user-facing toolkit across GitHub, Google Drive, Linear, Documents, Template Creator, Cloudflare and Infisical. D1 is the canonical operational database after cutover; Notion and n8n remain migration sources until verified retirement.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use OGENIC Phase VI. Discover the minimum required capability, route to the correct provider, execute the smallest reversible change, verify it, persist canonical state, and report only completion or the exact authorization required.
